# Insert using Query Builder

You can create `INSERT` queries using `QueryBuilder`.
Examples:

```typescript
await dataSource
    .createQueryBuilder()
    .insert()
    .into(User)
    .values([
        { firstName: "Timber", lastName: "Saw" },
        { firstName: "Phantom", lastName: "Lancer" },
    ])
    .execute()
```

This is the most efficient way in terms of performance to insert rows into your database.
You can also perform bulk insertions this way.

# Update using Query Builder

You can create `UPDATE` queries using `QueryBuilder`.
Examples:

```typescript
await dataSource
    .createQueryBuilder()
    .update(User)
    .set({ firstName: "Timber", lastName: "Saw" })
    .where("id = :id", { id: 1 })
    .execute()
```

This is the most efficient way in terms of performance to update entities in your database.
